title: One-way ANOVA with Tukey pairwise intervals
summary: The F test across three or more groups, then every pairwise mean difference with Tukey-adjusted 95% intervals.
pinned_defaults: R: factor(arm). With arm coded 1, 2, 3, aov without factor() fits one numeric slope on 1 df and prints an ordinary-looking table.
Python: groups split by arm label and passed to f_oneway and tukey_hsd, never a numeric arm column.
_equal_variances: Classical ANOVA and Tukey's HSD assume similar SDs across groups. With clearly unequal SDs prefer Welch's ANOVA and Games-Howell; with skewed outcomes, kruskal-wallis.
